name: Phinehas
description: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy

points: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the Lord of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were there.
So the high priest Eli had two sons named Hophni and Phinehas. Watch this.

note.label: When Children Walk in a Land of Shadows

points: Elkanah went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the Lord of hosts in Shiloh, where the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were. Shiloh is another name for Jerusalem.

note.label: 1 Samuel 1: Hannah's Vow and the Birth of Samuel

points: The ark of God was taken, and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain. Those two were wicked as hell, sleeping with the women that assembled at the door of the congregation and finessing the people's offerings, so in this battle the Most High allowed their lives to be taken, exactly as had been prophesied against the house of Eli.

note.label: 1 Samuel 4: The Ark of God Is Taken

points: Phinehas' wife was with child, near to be delivered, and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken and that her father in law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and travailed, giving birth before her time under all that misfortune.

note.label: 1 Samuel 4: The Ark of God Is Taken
